1: // Canvas Runner Game
2: // Implements endless runner per IDEA.md
3: // Enhanced graphics: gradient background, player silhouette, obstacle shading
4: 
5: (function () {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return;
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   const W = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
10:   const H = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400);
11: 
12:   // Game state
13:   let speed = 2;
14:   let score = 0;
15:   let running = true;
16: 
17:   // Player
18:   const player = {
19:     w: 30,
20:     h: 50,
21:     x: 50,
22:     y: H - 100,
23:     vy: 0,
24:     gravity: 0.6,
25:     jumpStrength: -12,
26:     onGround: false,
27:     draw() {
28:       // Simple silhouette (triangle) for better visual
29:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
30:       ctx.beginPath();
31:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y + this.h);
32:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w / 2, this.y);
33:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.w, this.y + this.h);
34:       ctx.closePath();
35:       ctx.fill();
36:     },
37:     update() {
38:       this.vy += this.gravity;
39:       this.y += this.vy;
40:       if (this.y + this.h >= groundY) {
41:         this.y = groundY - this.h;
42:         this.vy = 0;
43:         this.onGround = true;
44:       } else {
45:         this.onGround = false;
46:       }
47:     },
48:     jump() {
49:       if (this.onGround) this.vy = this.jumpStrength;
50:     },
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Ground line
54:   const groundY = H - 50;
55: 
56:   // Obstacles and orbs
57:   const obstacles = [];
58:   const orbs = [];
59:   const obstacleFreq = 120; // frames
60:   const orbFreq = 80;
61:   let frameCount = 0;
62: 
63:   function spawnObstacle() {
64:     const height = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
65:     obstacles.push({ x: W, y: groundY - height, w: 20, h: height });
66:   }
67: 
68:   function spawnOrb() {
69:     const radius = 8;
70:     const y = groundY - 100 - Math.random() * 150;
71:     orbs.push({ x: W, y, r: radius });
72:   }
73: 
74:   function updateObstacles() {
75:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
76:       const o = obstacles[i];
77:       o.x -= speed;
78:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
79:     }
80:   }
81: 
82:   function updateOrbs() {
83:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
84:       const o = orbs[i];
85:       o.x -= speed;
86:       if (o.x + o.r < 0) orbs.splice(i, 1);
87:     }
88:   }
89: 
90:   function checkCollisions() {
91:     // Player vs obstacles
92:     for (const o of obstacles) {
93:       if (
94:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
95:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
96:         player.y < o.y + o.h &&
97:         player.y + player.h > o.y
98:       ) {
99:         running = false;
100:         return;
101:       }
102:     }
103:     // Player vs orbs
104:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:       const o = orbs[i];
106:       const dx = player.x + player.w / 2 - (o.x + o.r);
107:       const dy = player.y + player.h / 2 - (o.y + o.r);
108:         if (dx * dx + dy * dy < (player.w / 2 + o.r) ** 2) {
109:           score += 10;
110:           orbs.splice(i, 1);
111:           // Play collection sound
112:           playSound(600, 0.07);
113:         }
114:       }
115:     }
116:   }
117: 
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   function drawBackground() {
122:     // Gradient sky that shifts hue with speed
123:     const hue = Math.floor((speed * 10) % 360);
124:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, 0);
125:     grad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${hue}, 80%, 60%)`);
126:     grad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${(hue + 60) % 360}, 80%, 40%)`);
127:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, groundY);
129:     // Ground with simple gradient shading
130:     const groundGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, groundY, 0, H);
131:     groundGrad.addColorStop(0, '#444');
132:     groundGrad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
133:     ctx.fillStyle = groundGrad;
134:     ctx.fillRect(0, groundY, W, H - groundY);
135:   }
136: 
137:     function drawObstacles() {
138:       // Obstacles with dark gradient shading
139:       for (const o of obstacles) {
140:         const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(o.x, o.y, o.x, o.y + o.h);
141:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#a22');
142:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#600');
143:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
144:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.w, o.h);
145:       }
146:     }
147: 
148:     function drawOrbs() {
149:       for (const o of orbs) {
150:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, o.r * 0.2, o.x, o.y, o.r);
151:         grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.9)');
152:         grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,165,0,0.4)');
153:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
154:         ctx.beginPath();
155:         ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
156:         ctx.fill();
157:       }
158:     }
159: 
160:   function drawScore() {
161:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
162:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
163:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
164:   }
165: 
166:   function loop() {
167:     if (!running) {
168:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
169:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
170:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
171:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
172:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 60, H / 2);
173:       ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, W / 2 - 50, H / 2 + 30);
174:       return;
175:     }
176:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
177: 
178:     // increase speed gradually
179:     speed += 0.001;
180: 
181:     // spawn entities
182:     if (frameCount % obstacleFreq === 0) spawnObstacle();
183:     if (frameCount % orbFreq === 0) spawnOrb();
184: 
185:     updateObstacles();
186:     updateOrbs();
187:     player.update();
188:     checkCollisions();
189: 
190:     drawBackground();
191:     drawObstacles();
192:     drawOrbs();
193:     player.draw();
194:     drawScore();
195: 
196:     frameCount++;
197:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
198:   }
199: 
200:   // Audio setup
201:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
202:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
203:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
204:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
205:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
206:     osc.type = 'sine';
207:     osc.connect(gain);
208:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
209:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
210:     osc.start();
211:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
212:   }
213: 
214:   // Input handling
215:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
216:     if (e.code === 'Space') {
217:       player.jump();
218:       audioCtx.resume();
219:       playSound(300, 0.1);
220:     }
221:   });
222:   canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
223:     player.jump();
224:     audioCtx.resume();
225:     playSound(300, 0.1);
226:   });
227: 
228:   // Start
229:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
230: })();
